title: Step-Back Jumper Reps
description: Advanced shooters practise creating separation with a hard step-back dribble move before rising into a jump shot, a staple of modern isolation scoring.

content.objective: Create clean separation with a controlled step-back before shooting in balance.
content.setup: Shooter starts with the ball just inside the three-point line, facing the basket.
instructions: Attack forward with one or two dribbles as if driving.
Push off and step back explosively while squaring the shoulders to the rim.
Land balanced with both feet set before releasing the shot.
Rebound and repeat from a different starting angle.
coachingPoints: Gather the ball before the step-back, not mid-air.
Land under control — a leaning landing ruins the shot.
Keep the same release point regardless of the move that set it up.
commonMistakes: Fading away instead of stepping straight back.
Rushing the shot before the feet are actually set.
Rushing the release instead of trusting the mechanics.
content.safety: Make sure there is enough clear space behind to step back safely.
